name: Separator
description:
A thin horizontal or vertical line between sections of related content.

  Separator()
  Separator(orientation: :vertical)
  Separator(variant: :wave, class: "text-primary my-4")

Drawn with currentColor (text-border by default) - recolor it with any text-* class. solid, dashed, double and gradient are CSS; dotted, wave and zigzag are a repeating SVG pattern.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Separator(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  if orientation.to_sym == :vertical
    div(class: "text-foreground flex h-12 items-center gap-4 text-sm") do
      span { "Left" }
      Separator(variant:, orientation:)
      span { "Right" }
    end
  else
    div(class: "text-foreground flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-4 text-sm") do
      span { "Above the line" }
      Separator(variant:)
      span { "Below the line" }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes:
solid, dashed, double and gradient are CSS borders; dotted, wave and zigzag a repeating SVG
pattern that scales with the width.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-5") do
    UI::Separator::VARIANTS.each_key do |variant|
      div(class: "flex flex-col gap-2") do
        span(class: "text-sm capitalize") { variant.to_s }
        Separator(variant:)
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Colors
examples.notes: The line uses currentColor: text-border by default, any text-* class to recolor it.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-5") do
    %w[ text-border text-border-strong text-border-intense text-primary text-secondary text-error text-success text-warning text-info ].each do |color|
      div(class: "flex flex-col gap-2") do
        span(class: "text-sm") { color }
        Separator(class: color)
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Vertical orientation
examples.notes: Vertical separators divide inline items and stretch to the row's height.

examples.name: In context
examples.notes: A horizontal rule between stacked sections and vertical rules between inline stats.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "border-border w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border p-5") do
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1") do
      h3(class: "text-foreground-intense font-medium") { "Mia Carter" }
      p(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm") { "Product designer based in Lisbon." }
    end
    Separator(class: "my-4")
    div(class: "flex justify-between text-sm") do
      [ %w[ 248 posts ], %w[ 12.4k followers ], %w[ 312 following ] ].each_with_index do |(count, label), index|
        Separator(orientation: :vertical, class: "mx-2.5") if index.positive?
        div do
          span(class: "font-semibold") { count }
          plain " #{label}"
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The items around a vertical separator follow the reading direction.
